install: set -euo pipefail; if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! go version | grep -q 'go1\.2'; then curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.22.12.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/go.tgz; sudo rm -rf /usr/local/go; sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tgz; fi; export PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH"; grep -q '/usr/local/go/bin' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.bashrc; go version; go test ./...
